market_intelligence.key_finding: Dubai legal market is heavily Arabic-dependent at law firm level. Most law firm roles require Arabic, especially below partner/senior associate. International tech/FMCG in-house roles are English-primary but tend to require 3–5+ years PQE. IP specialist paralegal/junior roles are the best fit for Tanya's profile but few are publicly posted. Best strategy: direct speculative applications to IP boutiques (Hadef, Gowling WLG) alongside monitoring LinkedIn/Indeed for fresh postings.
